Right edge fragments are cut off and partly illegible; the second column's ends are cropped. Several entries show ink blots over words (e.g. "Ciuis secundum", "clauepotentiæ"), read as best possible. The page is cut off at the top and in part of the middle. The lower-left columns are placed in the order they are read, left column then middle column, before the tall right column.
